**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**Meal report: save, share or print**
- Pick the dates: the last 7, 30 or 90 days, All time, or your own. The last 30 days is the default.
- Forkcast makes the report once, with a progress bar and a Cancel button, and shows it. Then Save it to a folder, Share it with another app, or Print it. Android's print screen can also save it as a PDF.
- A PDF of more than 60 days is a summary: your weight over time, monthly and weekly averages, and each day's totals against your targets. Turn on "Include every meal" to add each meal (it makes the report much longer). The spreadsheet always has every food.
- The copy Forkcast makes for sharing is deleted when you close the report.

**Backup & data is simpler**
- "Import settings" is gone. Backups have carried your settings and keys since 1.8.2, so "Restore from a backup" is the one way back.
